f.pu: To conserve biodiversity and to protect the cultural values of the country for future generations.
f.re: Visitors must obtain permission to visit these islands. Access to to the Indigenous Protected Area will only be granted for research and education purposes at the discretion of the Mabuyag community. Refer to the Management Plan for a list of General Visitation Protocols applicable to use by the Mabuyag community.
f.rn: Pulu Indigenous Protected Area Plan of Management
